sentences.text: I felt the air thickening in the living room starting at 04:20, where the chill began to pull me closer.
It was a cold spot, observing 16.9 °C, a temperature far below the house's expected 18.0 °C.
This presence lingered for a full 100 minutes, dropping below the expected range of 17.7 °C to 18.6 °C.
The reading found its deepest point, its peak, right around 05:20.
Finally, the icy sigh receded from the living room as the time approached 06:00.
